Bomb threats received by schools and government offices

Multiple bomb threat emails were sent to schools and government offices across India. In Jalalabad, two days after a police station blast, the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office and five schools received threats. In Delhi, three schools received similar emails, triggering evacuations. Authorities in Delhi declared these threats to be hoaxes after initial investigations. The nature of the threats and the sender remain under investigation.
